title: Northgate Optical Material Cancellation Refund: Calculation Basis
content:
**Material cancellation refund — Northgate Optical.** The material cancellation refund in an in-lab cancellation is 60 percent of the material upgrade charge less every credit already posted against it, rounded to the cent. The refundable material amount is the net material upgrade charge in full.

**Net material upgrade charge.** The material upgrade charge of the original order (remake number 0), as posted — after any Plus discount — less every credit already posted against material upgrade charges of the job.

**Order of working.** The material cancellation refund is worked out in this order: the refundable material amount is first multiplied by the material refund share, the material spend bonus is then added and the treated-blank deduction taken off, and the result is floored at zero and rounded to the cent once.

| Line | Value |
|---|---|
| Refundable material amount | the net material upgrade charge in full |
| Material refund share | 60 percent |
| Material spend bonus | 0.00 |
| Treated-blank deduction | 0.00 |
| Floor and rounding | floored at zero, rounded to the cent once |

## Worked figures (hypothetical jobs)

| Material upgrade charge | Credits against it | Net | 60 percent | Material cancellation refund |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 45.00 | none | 45.00 | 27.00 | 27.00 |
| 38.25 | none | 38.25 | 22.95 | 22.95 |
| 120.00 | none | 120.00 | 72.00 | 72.00 |
| 70.00 | 70.00 already refunded | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
